stories.title: Senedd rejects bid to pause Wales drinks deposit return scheme
stories.summary: Glass stays in the Welsh scheme after MSs reject calls for a pause and a review, leaving Deeside on the border with England's scheme without glass.

stories.title: Coleg Cambria named College of the Year, and a Deeside lecturer is among the UK’s best
stories.summary: Coleg Cambria was crowned College of the Year at a prestigious national awards ceremony, with one of its leading lecturers recognised among the UK’s best. The college secured the top honour at the VTCT Skills Excellence Awards 2026, held at Rugby College, while Kelly Pasicznyk, Hairdressing Lecturer and Equity Specialist at Deeside, was highly commended

stories.title: Growing up in Flintshire: what new social mobility data shows
stories.summary: Flintshire is in the lower band of UK council areas for young people’s job opportunities and for the conditions children grow up in, new figures from the Social Mobility Commission show. The commission’s State of the Nation 2026 report was published on 29 October. It puts 205 local authorities across the UK into seven bands

stories.title: Police appeal for witnesses after man suffers life-threatening injuries on A55 slip road at St Asaph
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for witnesses after a man suffered life-threatening injuries in a collision on the A55 at St Asaph this morning. Two cars were involved in a minor collision on the westbound slip road at junction 27 at about 7am on Wednesday, 25 November, and the drivers got out of their vehicles.

stories.title: Public Health Wales contacting people affected by Test and Post Hepatitis B testing error
stories.summary: Public Health Wales has apologised after some people using its postal sexual health testing service were tested for Hepatitis B immunity rather than Hepatitis B infection.
